caption: On 18 November the Studio card still read GENERATING MEDIA at 14:47, 21 minutes after we started a 30 second Short. VidPal says this step usually takes 30 to 90 seconds.
Once you confirm the script it locks, with a warning that each regeneration counts as another video in your quota. Confirming took 1 of our 4 free credits before any video existed.
The Settings & Media tab kept spinning on Generating voice & captions over a black preview. VidPal refused our 2 retries because this render still counted as in progress.
Annual plans under a 50% off for life-time banner: Starter $12, Pro $23 and Business $41 a month, billed as $144, $276 and $492 a year. Free gives 4 lifetime credits.

Retest on 21 November, after VidPal said the outage was fixed: the Short played about 55 seconds after Generate, with word by word captions. The stock clip showed a snowboarder walking, not waxing. Account initials are hidden.
